business_summary: Shanghai New Centurion Network Information Technology Co., Ltd. provides IT data center operation and maintenance products and services in China. The company offers ZnAiops intelligent operation and maintenance management platform, unified intelligent monitoring platform, CMDB IT asset management platform, automated operation and maintenance management platform, big data log analysis platform, panoramic observation platform, Agile ITSM service management platform, application release management platform, intelligent middle platform, and low-code development platform. It also provides database ecosystem services, ZnSQL heterogeneous database intelligent management platform, SQL audit management platform, integrated batch processing data platform, data governance platform, data visualization, data asset management, NewSQL database cloud management platform, and domestic IT database solutions. In addition, the company offers financial industry business end-to-end monitoring solution, SRE operation and maintenance solutions for the insurance industry, intelligent operation and maintenance solution for the healthcare industry, digital operation and maintenance solutions for the power industry, SRE operation and maintenance capability solution for the telecom industry, IT services in the manufacturing industry, intelligent operation and maintenance solutions for the transportation industry, smart campus solutions for the education industry, domestic IT database solutions, and intelligent operation and maintenance solution based on cloud-native observable solutions. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
